item.title: Remains of 81-Year-Old Man Recovered After Fatal Nassau Street House Fire
item.description: WINNIPEG -- The remains of an 81-year-old man have been recovered following a fatal Winnipeg house fire last weekend.

item.title: Downtown Winnipeg BIZ Launches ‘Dine and Discover’ to Spice Up Late-Winter Slump
item.description: Winnipeggers looking to shake off the late-winter chill will soon have a new excuse to grab a table downtown.

item.title: Winnipeg Security Guard Arrested After Alleged Assault in Downtown Dollarama
item.description: A security guard has been arrested following the assault on a suspected shoplifter at a downtown convenience store last weekend, police say.

item.title: New Flyer Opens All-Canadian Bus Manufacturing Facility in Winnipeg
item.description: New Flyer has opened a new all-Canadian bus manufacturing facility in Winnipeg, calling it a major boost for domestic production, job creation and zero-emission transit.

item.title: Winnipeg Police Bail Compliance Unit Makes 336 Arrests in First Two Months
item.description: A new Winnipeg police bail compliance unit is now up and running, having already resulted in 336 arrests in the first two months of operation.

item.title: Jets Overtime Win Over Blackhawks Shows Signs They Refuse to Quit
item.description: Scott Arniel couldn't help himself. Moments after his Winnipeg Jets secured a dramatic 3-2 overtime victory over the Chicago Blackhawks at Canada Life Centre on Tuesday, the head coach was already checking the out-of-town scoreboard.

item.title: Man Arrested After Shots Fired at Stop Sign in RM of Cartier
item.description: A 47-year-old man is facing firearms-related charges after reports of shots fired near an intersection in the RM of Cartier.

item.title: Winnipeg’s River Trail Closes for Season After 62 Days
item.description: The Nestaweya River Trail is now officially closed for the season as warmer temperatures and rising river levels make ice conditions unsafe.

item.title: Winnipeg Transit Launches Live Bus Tracking on App and Navigo
item.description: Winnipeg Transit riders can now track buses in near-real-time using GPS through the Navigo trip planner and the Winnipeg Transit app.

item.title: Daughter of Manitoba Woman Killed in Dominican Bus Crash Left in Dark on Dad’s Condition
item.description: The daughter of a Manitoba woman killed in a bus crash in the Dominican Republic says her family is still searching for answers three days after the incident that left another Canadian dead and 13 others injured.
